topic: Three habits of senior engineers that juniors skip
title: 3 habits senior engineers never skip
description: Three small habits that separate senior engineers from juniors: read first, name things, and leave the code better than you found it.

cues.narration: Three habits of senior engineers that juniors skip.
One. Read first. Spend two minutes in the code before you write a single line.
Two. Name things so the next person understands them without asking you.
Three. Leave it better than you found it. One small fix per visit, every visit.

outro: Follow for one build lesson a day.
